title: Two-finger scrolling
drDigitalIntro:
Scrolling lets you see more of a long page.
• On a trackpad: place two fingers side by side and slide them down.
• On a mouse: roll the scroll wheel with your index finger.
• The page moves under your fingers — more content appears from the bottom.
• Sliding your fingers up scrolls back toward the top.

playgroundTask.instructions: Scroll down using two fingers until you find the secret code, then type it into the box.

drDigitalSuccess: You found the code at the bottom of the page. Two-finger scrolling is officially yours.
drDigitalHint: Two fingers on the trackpad — slide them down to scroll. On a mouse, roll the wheel down. Keep scrolling until the secret code appears.
